title: Doctor Strange Keeps Saving Her. Why Does She Still Die?
question: What drives the characters’ choices and how does the story resolve?

sources.title: SYFY Wire: What If episode four recap
sources.excerpt: The alternate crash kills Christine; repeated attempts fail; the absolute point drives absorption over centuries, two selves, their duel and the universe/crystal ending.

sources.title: Laughing Place: What If episode four
sources.excerpt: Corroborates the cause chain, Ancient One split, power absorption, frightened Christine, Watcher refusal and final collapse.

sources.title: Disney: alternate Doctor Strange continuity
sources.excerpt: Official Disney context identifies the fourth What If episode and the altered crash losing Christine instead of his hands.

claims.text: What If season one episode four changes the crash so Christine dies instead of Strange’s hands being injured.
The loss leads Strange to magic. He defeats Dormammu but later uses time travel to try to undo Christine’s death.
Different choices still lead to Christine’s death; the Ancient One calls it an absolute point because the loss leads him to sorcery and saving the universe.
Strange seeks greater power and spends centuries absorbing mystical creatures, becoming monstrous.
The Ancient One split Strange into two selves; the other accepted the death rather than following the absorption path.
The good Strange tries to stop his counterpart; the corrupted one defeats and absorbs him.
Strange revives Christine, frightens her, and cannot stop reality collapsing. The Watcher refuses to interfere.
The universe collapses, Christine vanishes, and Strange remains alone inside a small crystalline refuge.

notes: What If…? S1E4 (2021), alternate animated reality. Secondary episode recaps were compared with official Disney continuity metadata; no full-episode viewing is claimed.
